turns.text: How to make the seller choose you over other agents? A million dollar question each and every agent would love to know. First of all, you cannot stop anyone from trying to find the best much. The same as you cannot stop your girlfriend from maybe, you know, flirt with other guys. What you can do is a little bit different. Instead of protecting your seller, be up front. Say, look, Mr. Seller, if I were in your shoes, I probably would talk to several agents just to see which one is the right person for the job. What I can do for you if you like, I can walk you through my marketing plan, which helps that quantity of sellers to actually get the highest possible price for their unit. Would that help you if I will do that?
